summary: The filing is an 8-K/A that corrects clerical errors in a prior 8-K regarding the signature block date and exhibit numbering. It does not disclose any special situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC-related substantive event, or management change as a standalone event. Instead, it references press releases (Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2) whose content is not detailed in the excerpt but appear to be routine shareholder communications.
